screenNotes: All three make every S07 required state visibly findable and use useful texture/line/glyph treatments for the material kinds. All three nevertheless reject: each claims a Euclidean rhythm while rendering the wrong number of onsets, and none includes the accessibility annotation, icon labels, responsive rule, component mapping, token-deviation record, or behavioral specification required for S8 implementation-authoritative handoff. No text is visibly garbled or misspelled; the defects are semantic and mathematical, not OCR noise.
recommendationReason: A-instrument is the least compromised visual base: it has the clearest cross-surface selection chain, the most complete source-status/evidence treatment, and the strongest compact instrument shell. It remains rejected until its E(7,12) ring is corrected to seven Euclidean onsets and the absent S8 accessibility, behavior, responsive, component-mapping, and token-deviation evidence is supplied.
